scope: Actual TaskMetrics and Sidebar React with authored DTO and IPC fixtures; no provider or native acceptance

checks.name: Host totals, TPS, duration and actual model appear
Build label is static, reports host version and has no navigation semantics
Missing host version has no invented release number
Missing usage and speed are unknown, not zero
Partial sums and partial TPS are explicitly marked
Multiple runtime models remain separately identifiable
Long model identities stay within a 320px chat column
Read uses the durable message/session identity
Late previous-session result cannot overwrite the current operation
Mismatched response identity is rejected without fabricated totals
Stop-before-persistence race refetches final durable metrics
Read failure remains a readable unavailable state
No real input, focus or Pointer Lock requested
